Knowhow / AI & automation / A knowledge base that answers with sources
AI & AUTOMATION · CASE STUDY

Has anybody already built an AI knowledge base that answers with sources?

Turning scattered team knowledge into answers you can trust.

The question

How do you help a team find a reliable answer without asking them to learn another tool?

The approach

Start with a narrow collection of reviewed documents. Retrieve relevant passages before generating an answer, and show the source beside every claim. Make “I don’t know” a useful outcome.

The tradeoff

A smaller, reviewed knowledge set produces fewer answers, but makes mistakes easier to investigate. Freshness and ownership matter as much as retrieval quality.

What to take with you

Measure whether someone found a supported answer, not whether the assistant replied. Give document owners a queue of unanswered questions.
